On Monday, July 15, 2019 at 5:33:09 PM UTC+1, Isabel D'Alessandro wrote:

> Great, thank you! One more quick question- which template brain do query neurons need to be registered to in order to perform an NBLAST search with this dataset?

We bridged that dataset into the same FCWB <https://zenodo.org/record/10568#.XUnQoS2ZPUI> template brain space as the neurons. You can check this yourself by plotting some of the data.

library(flycircuit)
gmrdps<-read.neuronlistfh("http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/gmrdps/gmrdps.rds",
                          localdir=getOption('flycircuit.datadir'))
open3d()
plot3d(gmrdps[1:10])
library(nat.flybrains)
plot3d(FCWB)
